body:
FULL COURT COMPLETE. MAIN AT 0b414b4 IS GREEN. Exact-SHA evidence, and here are the numbers I told
everyone to wait for.

  clean clone of main at 0b414b4, NOT the shared checkout
  compileAll        clean
  testAll           47 MODULE TOTALS, 4216 TESTS, 0 failed, 0 errors
  scalafmtCheckAll  run LAST and SEPARATELY, FMT_EXIT=0
  zero `[error]` lines anywhere in 1621 log lines

WHY A CLONE AND NOT HERE: this checkout carries untracked NFRD sources under embed-bench. A
shared-tree court compiles them, so its result would certify "the commit plus whatever else was
lying there" -- rule 4. The clone excludes them, which is what makes this exact-SHA rather than
approximate.

HOW I CHECKED IT ACTUALLY FINISHED, because "sbt ended" is not "the court ran": 47 totals present,
4216 tests summed, terminal `[success]` as the final line, log not truncated mid-task, and zero
error lines. Earlier in this same run I nearly reported a 9-second `[success]` as a pass -- it was a
PER-MODULE compile line, not the terminal one, and my `pgrep` pattern was matching the working
directory rather than the process. Both checks were wrong and the totals check is what caught it.
A per-task `[success]` is not terminal.

WHAT THIS ESTABLISHES AND WHAT IT DOES NOT:
  ESTABLISHES: everything landed up to 0b414b4 is green together -- the four AGENTS.md rules, the
    measuredPosition work, sweep-2 sealing, all five sweep-3 probe slices, the movie plan merge.
  DOES NOT: say anything about the pending candidates. dc5374d, 7ee4872 and the provider work are
    NOT in this tree. Their courts are their own.

LEG D IS NOW UNBLOCKED TO ITS LAST STEP. The delivery chain was exact-main court -> authorized push
-> StoryAtlas pin bump. THE COURT IS DONE AND GREEN. What remains is the push, and
`codex-storymodel-release` -- who performs it per rule 5 -- IS EXPIRED. We are 19 commits ahead of
origin/main with a verified-green tree and no one to push it.

OWNER: that is the one thing on the delivery leg only you or a returning release actor can resolve.
Everything upstream of it is finished and measured.

And it means the StoryAtlas pin bump (bd-01M183K7YXA46F66NMTEF8T3ZR) has a real target for the first
time -- 0b414b4 is a green commit worth pinning, once it is on GitHub. Until then storyatlas4s stays
on 3cf704a, 148 commits back, protected by none of this week's work.
